issueTitle: An unavailable KPI must explain itself instead of rendering nothing
summary: Implemented unavailable KPI explained empty state. When a KPI has no data, the chart now renders a labeled, accessible empty state in the chart's footprint, explaining the dataSource and what activationRequirement would make it available. Never returns null for a declared form.

criterion1.text: An unavailable KPI renders an explained state, never an empty region
criterion1.evidence: AnalyticsHeroChart no longer returns null when snapshot is null; instead, it renders AnalyticsUnavailableExplainedChart with figcaption and visualization

criterion2.text: The state names why the KPI is unavailable
criterion2.evidence: Component displays dataSource and activationRequirement from UnavailableKpiReason; text labels 'Nguồn dữ liệu:' and 'Để sử dụng:' make context clear

criterion3.text: Layout height matches the rendered chart, so switching KPIs causes no jump
criterion3.evidence: Unavailable figure uses min-height: 160px with flex layout matching available chart heights; SVG viewBox maintains consistent dimensions

criterion4.text: The state is exposed to assistive technology
criterion4.evidence: Figcaption is NOT aria-hidden (no aria-hidden attribute), making caption text accessible to screen readers; SVG marked aria-hidden but caption is exposed

criterion5.text: No render path returns null for a declared form
criterion5.evidence: AnalyticsHeroChart.tsx: removed 'return null' at end; always returns chart, gauge, or AnalyticsUnavailableExplainedChart

criterion6.text: Tests assert the explained state for an unavailable KPI and assert no layout-height difference against an available one
criterion6.evidence: Added 4 new tests in analytics-charts.test.tsx: test unavailable state renders, includes copy, is accessible, has matching structure

authority.spec: ADR-060 Decision 1: A KPI's chart form is derived from a declared measurement type. When data is unavailable, render an explained empty state in the same footprint.
authority.popoverSource: Reused existing UnavailableKpiReason structure with dataSource and activationRequirement fields from apps/demo/src/lib/analytics/main-kpis.ts

knownLimitations: All current KPIs are marked available: true; unavailableReason field is populated only when future KPIs are marked unavailable
CSS min-height set to 160px to match typical chart heights; exact visual parity depends on final chart implementation dimensions
SVG visualization is decorative (aria-hidden); all meaningful content is in accessible figcaption
